mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news_activities (child_id, article_id, child_answer, is_completed, viewed_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{childId}, #{articleId}, #{childAnswer}, #{isCompleted}, #{viewedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE news_activities SET child_answer = #{childAnswer}, is_completed = #{isCompleted}, viewed_at = #{viewedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
